market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from US-Iran escalation, Fed hawkishness, and rate-hike repricing. Expect volatility in equities, oil spikes, and FX turbulence (yen). EM outperformance continues. Tech sector vulnerable to rate sensitivity. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias with energy and EM as relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact despite near-term valuation concerns. EM structural growth (India, China dividend) offers 6-12 month upside. Energy transition (lithium, battery storage) is a multi-year theme. Fed tightening cycle may peak, creating eventual equity recovery. Geopolitical fragmentation (Hormuz, Venezuela) reshapes energy geography permanently.
